title: Admin can log in and be routed to admin dashboard
description: Verifies that a user with admin role can log in successfully and is automatically redirected to the admin dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the admin dashboard

title: Viewer can log in and be routed to viewer dashboard
description: Verifies that a user with viewer role can log in successfully and is automatically redirected to the viewer dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the viewer dashboard

title: Logout from admin clears session and returns to login
description: Verifies logging out from the admin portal returns to the login page and the admin page is no longer accessible without logging in again.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Unauthenticated user is blocked from admin dashboard
description: Verifies that navigating directly to the admin dashboard without a stored auth session redirects to the login page.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Unauthenticated user is blocked from viewer dashboard
description: Verifies that navigating directly to the viewer dashboard without a stored auth session redirects to the login page.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Admin can manage a product end-to-end (add, edit, delete) with count updates
description: Verifies an admin can add a product, edit it, then delete it and the product list and total count reflect each change.

steps.description: Fill Unique Product A into the product name field
Open the edit product modal for Unique Product A
Fill Unique Product A Updated into the product name field
Initiate delete for Unique Product A Updated
Verify the product is no longer present in the product list and the total product count reflects the removal

title: Already-authenticated admin is redirected away from login page
description: Verifies that an authenticated admin visiting the login page is automatically routed to the admin dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the admin dashboard

title: Admin can view catalogue list and total count on load
description: Verifies the admin products page loads a product table and shows a total product count.

steps.description: Verify the product list is displayed in a data table
Verify a total product count is displayed in a stats card

title: Viewer can browse catalogue with total count on load
description: Verifies a viewer can open the dashboard and see a read-only product table and total product count.

steps.description: Verify the viewer product list is displayed in a data table
Verify a total product count is displayed in a stats card

title: Admin role is blocked from viewer dashboard
description: Verifies that an authenticated admin cannot access the viewer dashboard and is redirected to the login page per current guard behavior.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Viewer read-only table has no row actions
description: Verifies the viewer dashboard does not expose edit/delete actions in the product table.

steps.description: Verify the product table does not include controls for editing or deleting items

title: New user can register as Viewer and return to login
description: Verifies that a new user can register with viewer role and is redirected back to the login page on success.

steps.description: Fill Test Viewer into the full name field
Fill test_viewer_user into the username field
Fill test_viewer_pass into the password field
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Admin search filters product list and updates stats
description: Verifies an admin can search the catalogue and see filtered results with an updated total count.

steps.description: Fill a valid keyword from an existing product into the search field
Verify the product list is filtered to matching items
Verify the total product count reflects the filtered results

title: Admin can clear search to restore full list and count
description: Verifies clearing the search query restores the full product list and total count.

steps.description: Fill a valid keyword from an existing product into the search field
Verify the full product list is displayed again
Verify the total product count reflects the full catalogue

title: Invalid login shows global error banner
description: Verifies that incorrect credentials prevent login and show a global invalid-credentials error state.

steps.description: Fill invalid_user into the username field
Fill invalid_password into the password field
Verify a global login error banner is visible

title: Admin can cancel deletion and item remains
description: Verifies canceling the delete confirmation leaves the product in the list and does not change the total count.

steps.description: Fill Cancel Delete Product into the product name field
Initiate delete for Cancel Delete Product
Verify the product is still present in the product list
Verify the total product count did not decrease after canceling

title: Login required-field validation blocks submission
description: Verifies that submitting the login form with missing required fields shows inline validation errors and does not proceed to a dashboard.

steps.description: Verify inline required-field validation errors are visible

title: Admin sees a stable no-results state for unmatched search
description: Verifies an admin searching for a non-matching keyword shows a no-results state without breaking the table or stats UI.

steps.description: Fill a unique gibberish query into the search field
Verify a no-results state is shown for the product list
Verify the page remains usable with the stats card still displayed

title: Admin validation prevents saving an incomplete product
description: Verifies the add product form blocks saving when required fields are missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Fill Incomplete Product into the product name field
Verify a product form validation error is visible
Verify no new product is added to the product list

title: Registration requires role selection
description: Verifies that registration cannot be submitted without choosing a role and shows an inline role-required error.

steps.description: Fill No Role User into the full name field
Fill no_role_user into the username field
Fill any_password into the password field
Verify an inline role-required validation error is visible

title: Registration enforces username minimum length
description: Verifies that a too-short username is rejected with an inline validation error during registration.

steps.description: Fill Short Name into the full name field
Fill ab into the username field
Fill any_password into the password field
Verify an inline username length validation error is visible

title: Admin pagination controls update the visible table slice
description: Verifies an admin can change pages using pagination controls and the visible product rows update accordingly.

steps.description: Click a different pagination page control
Verify the product table updates to show a different set of rows

title: Password visibility can be toggled on login
description: Verifies that toggling password visibility on the login form changes the password field between masked and unmasked states.

steps.description: Fill any_password into the password field
Verify the password field is displayed as unmasked text

title: Viewer can read informational cards by scrolling
description: Verifies the viewer can scroll to and see the informational cards content area.

steps.description: Scroll to the informational cards section

title: Password visibility can be toggled on registration
description: Verifies that toggling password visibility on the registration form changes the password field between masked and unmasked states.

steps.description: Fill any_password into the password field
Verify the password field is displayed as unmasked text
